quiz_title: Class 72 Quiz: Vachanamrut & Purushottam Bolya Prite

questions.question_text: Vach.Ga.Ma.63 states: "Bhagwānnā bhakta chhe te to kevaḷ __________ ja murtio chhe."
questions.explanation: As stated in Vach.Ga.Ma.63, "Bhagwānnā bhakta chhe te to kevaḷ brahmanī ja murtio chhe."

questions.question_text: According to Vach.Ga.Ma.63, what should one not bring towards Bhagwān's devotees?
questions.explanation: Vach.Ga.Ma.63 explicitly states: "...ene viṣhe to manuṣhyabhāv lāvvo ja nahī."

questions.question_text: Purushottam Bolya Prite states: "Bhagwānne bhajtā sarve harijano __________ chhe."
questions.explanation: The text from Purushottam Bolya Prite says: "Bhagwānne bhajtā sarve harijano divya chhe."

questions.question_text: According to Purushottam Bolya Prite, those who understand, remember, and contemplate the profound secret become magna thaī jāy chhe ne __________.
questions.explanation: Purushottam Bolya Prite states: "...te magna thaī jāy chhe ne jag jītī jāy chhe."

questions.question_text: For those who understand, remember, and contemplate the profound secret, their joy never diminishes for how long, according to Purushottam Bolya Prite?
questions.explanation: Purushottam Bolya Prite mentions: "Āṭho pahar ānand eno ṭaḷto nathī."

questions.question_text: According to Purushottam Bolya Prite, what three actions do those who become engrossed and conquer the world perform regarding the profound secret?
options: juve, vicāre ne prārthanā kare chhe
questions.explanation: The text states: "Ā marmnī vāt je koī samaje, dhāre ne vichāre chhe te magna thaī jāy chhe..."

questions.question_text: Which text states: "Bhagwānnā bhakta chhe te to kevaḷ brahmanī ja murtio chhe..."?
questions.explanation: This statement is found in Vach.Ga.Ma.63.

questions.question_text: Which text contains the statement: "Bhagwānne bhajtā sarve harijano divya chhe."
questions.explanation: This statement is found in Purushottam Bolya Prite.

questions.question_text: According to Vach.Ga.Ma.63, what is the nature of Bhagwān's devotees?
options: te to kevaḷ brahmanī ja murtio chhe
questions.correct_answer: te to kevaḷ brahmanī ja murtio chhe
questions.explanation: Vach.Ga.Ma.63 states: "Bhagwānnā bhakta chhe te to kevaḷ brahmanī ja murtio chhe."

questions.question_text: What is the "marmnī vāt" (profound secret) mentioned in Purushottam Bolya Prite?
options: Bhagwānne bhajtā sarve harijano divya chhe.
Bhagwānne bhajtā sarve harijano māyik chhe.
Bhagwānne bhajtā sarve harijano sāmānya manuṣhya chhe.
Bhagwānne bhajtā sarve harijano kevaḷ kalyāṇnā kām kare chhe.
questions.correct_answer: Bhagwānne bhajtā sarve harijano divya chhe.
questions.explanation: Purushottam Bolya Prite refers to "Bhagwānne bhajtā sarve harijano divya chhe" as the "marmnī vāt."
